acceptanceCriteria: User provides specific changes to implement

file_operations.description: Review the current application structure and section orchestration to prepare for applying version 2 changes once specifications are provided. Ensure all existing sections (Header, HeroSection, WhySection, MenuHighlightsSection, TestimonialsSection, CelebrationSection, LocationSection, FinalCTASection, Footer) remain functional while awaiting specific modification requirements.
